# Exeter Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Exeter, Huron County, Exeter Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 901-0020  |  Email: contact@exeterheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://exeterheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Exeter, Seaforth, Crediton, Dashwood, Brucefield, Centralia
